name: HS Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: HS Holdings Co., Ltd. provides merger and acquisition intermediary services in Japan and the Kyrgyz Republic. The company offers business succession consulting, restructuring investment, business investment management, venture investment, and business revitalization consulting services. It also imports and exports second-hand and new jewelry, precious metals, watches, and bags. The company was formerly known as Sawada Holdings Co., Ltd. HS Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
